scripts.dev: pnpm build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @scorelens/api dev" "pnpm --filter @scorelens/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @scorelens/api build && pnpm --filter @scorelens/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @scorelens/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @scorelens/web typecheck
